BiblicalUsage: Pâlîyṭ is the one who escaped, the refugee, the survivor. One who had escaped comes and tells Abram that his brother is taken, the escaped of the nations are called to draw near to the LORD, and Edom is warned not to stand in the crossway to cut off those of his people who escape.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the escaped one is a witness: he carries the news, he is called to come near, and God notices who stands in his way.
